description: Numbers behind Skyrim's progression, read from the player's Skyrim.esm (GMST records). fallback is only used when a value is absent from the file, and is logged.

columns.source: GMST editor id, AVSK field, or 'fixed'
columns.fallback: value used only when the record is missing (logged)
columns.read_verified: yes once read from a real Skyrim.esm

rows.used_for: character XP for the next level = base + mult x level
character XP per skill increase = this x new skill level
skill XP to next level = improve_mult x level^curve + improve_offset
every skill's starting level before race bonuses
skill level cap (Skyrim's 100, no Legendary in 0.1)
perk points gained per character level
skill XP per use = use_mult x base_xp + use_offset
